1.  **Calculate the position of the minute hand:**
    The minute hand moves 360° in 1 hour (60 minutes).
    At 2:30, the minute hand has been moving for 30 minutes.
    $$ \text{Angle}_{\text{minute}} = 30 \times 6^\circ = 180^\circ $$

2.  **Calculate the position of the hour hand:**
    The hour hand moves 360° in 12 hours (or 30° per hour).
    At 2:30, the hour hand has moved for 30 minutes past the hour mark (2:00).
    $$ \text{Angle}_{\text{hour}} = 2 \times 30^\circ + 30 \times 6^\circ = 60^\circ + 180^\circ = 240^\circ $$

3.  **Calculate the difference between the angles:**
    The smaller angle is the absolute difference between the positions of the two hands.
    $$ \text{Difference} = |240^\circ - 180^\circ| = 60^\circ $$

Therefore, the degree measure of the smaller angle between the hour hand and the minute hand is **60**.
